thread:
elena: quick follow-up after yesterday's batcher deep-dive. i'm worried our compaction steals ordering guarantees in subtle ways. proposal: introduce 'island fences' so compaction is order-preserving within bounded islands.

sam: simple ask: what's an island fence in one line?

elena: an island = contiguous set of requests the queue can reorder freely, but fences mark boundaries that cannot be crossed. fences are created per-tenant or per-route based on config.

raj: ok. how do fences differ from the enqueue_strict/compactable lanes we've discussed before?

elena: lanes are coarse. fences let us keep compact packing inside islands while preserving inter-island ordering. so you can compact within an island without affecting downstream ordering across fences.

noah: practical: do we create fences per-request, per-window, or per-tenant?

elena: defaults: per-tenant fences when tenant opts-out of mixing; per-route policy can set soft fences every N ms or after a streaming-start event. SDK can add explicit fence_hint.

sam: how are fences signaled to scheduler? we need a compact API.

elena: proto tweak: Request { route, payload, compaction_hint, fence_hint? } queue emits EnqueueEvent with fence_id if set. scheduler and kv-cache use fence_id to scope affinity & eviction safety.

raj: must ensure fence_id is stable for the life of the request. also, putting fence ids in headers is brittle. proto field only.

elena: agreed. header fallback discouraged. proto field wins; missing fence_hint => queue picks default based on route config.

noah: what about island sizing? too small and we lose packing; too big and we leak ordering. knobs: island_max_ms and island_max_reqs. experiments needed.

elena: suggested starting point: island_max_ms=30ms for small requests, island_max_reqs=16. keep tunable by route.

sam: observability: we need metrics to measure "island-perturbation" (how much order changed) and per-island cache_miss_delta.

elena: yes: emit island_applied{route,fence_id,level}, island_move_count, island_latency_delta_p50_p99, kv_miss_delta. dashboards + decomp alerts.

raj: failure modes: streaming sessions getting split across islands causing head-of-line blocking. mitigation: special fence for active-stream sessions (never compact across).

elena: exactly. make session-start an implicit fence. that keeps streams safe.

noah: performance: building fences and tracking per-island metadata adds CPU & memory. consider lightweight 64-bit fence ids and recycle them; keep metadata off hot-path as much as possible.

elena: implementation plan: queue-side islandizer (hot-path picks fence id, lightweight local ring buffer for island queueing), background coalescer applies aggressive packing within island, emits events. offload heavy heuristics off hot-path.

sam: proto sample (pseudo):

message Request {
  string route = 1;
  bytes payload = 2;
  enum CompactionHint { NONE = 0; GENTLE = 1; AGGRESSIVE = 2; }
  CompactionHint compaction_hint = 3;
  string fence_hint = 4; // optional, e.g. "session:1234" or "tenant-wide"
}
queue.enqueue(Request r)

elena: rollout checklist: (1) proto + SDK sample, (2) queue islandizer + coalescer prototype, (3) telemetry + {island,kv} dashboards, (4) canary small percent with synthetic tenants, (5) stress tests with mixed streaming + small interactive, (6) auto-fallback runbook.

raj: acceptance criteria for canary: p99 delta <=5% and kv_miss_delta <=2% over 7d. also ensure no stream starvation detected.

ci-bot: preview-branch created: "island-fences/compact-proto". smoke tests queued.

elena: thanks all. i'll draft the RFC section for island fences and post an updated proto diff. ping me if you want to review. :raised_hands:
